title: Recap: *-ás/-és* nouns and *joga van* in a legal text

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: You know verbal nouns in *-ás/-és* from B1 Unit 16 and the official register from C1 Unit 8. Medical law uses them to name rights: *a kezelés visszautasítása*, *az önrendelkezési jog*. In Hungary a patient with an incurable, terminal illness can refuse life-sustaining treatment under strict conditions set by law.

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: A living will (*élő végrendelet*) is a document in which a patient states in advance which treatments they refuse. Active euthanasia (*aktív eutanázia*) is a crime in Hungary.

sections.title: Patterns in Context
rows: Bizonyos feltételek mellett a betegnek joga van visszautasítani az életfenntartó kezelést.
Under certain conditions the patient has the right to refuse life-sustaining treatment.
A palliatív ellátás célja a szenvedés enyhítése.
The aim of palliative care is to ease suffering.
Az élő végrendelet a beteg előzetes akaratának írásos kinyilvánítása.
The living will is the written statement of the patient's advance wishes.
